name: Srichandra
contribution: A Chandra dynasty ruler associated with southeastern Bengal’s regional state formation.
context: His reign helps represent Samatata-Harikela politics and Buddhist institutional patronage outside the Pala heartland.
impact: He broadens the pre-sultanate map of Bengal by foregrounding eastern Bengal’s political and monastic networks.
